Historically, Korea established public and private facilities; postwar care shifted toward outpatient, home-based management.

articleHeadline: Complex developments in the animal disease outbreak in Tuyên Quang Province.
articleSummary: On 12 August 2026, the Tuyên Quang Province People’s Committee issued Directive No. 6350 to strengthen autumn–winter vaccination and prevent animal diseases. African swine fever (ASF) has been detected in 42 communes/wards, with 16 of them not yet past 21 days since outbreak. Avian influenza A/H5N1 has caused three outbreaks in Đồng Tâm, Việt Lâm and Tân Quang; foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in Mèo Vạc and Lũng Phìn; lumpy skin disease in Lùng Tám, Thắng Mố, Cán Tỷ, Minh Tân, Minh Sơn and Đường Hồng. Authorities must implement measures under the Veterinary Law, decisively targeting active foci of ASF, A/H5N1 and lumpy skin disease to prevent wider spread. Local budgets should fund vaccines and conduct mass vaccination in September–October 2026, aiming for at least 80% vaccination coverage for the listed diseases (lumpy skin disease, FMD, hemorrhagic septicemia, A/H5N1, ASF). Commune chairpersons are accountable to the provincial government if vaccination fails to meet the target.

articleHeadline: Former Unit 731 members confirm that the Japanese army buried poison gas bombs in China; new historical materials reveal details of biological warfare and poison gas experiments - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong).
articleSummary: Harbin’s 731 Memorial Hall released two new sources on Unit 731: the Hailar Detachment archival file and the oral testimony of hygienist Ozaki. The detachment, code-named Manchuria 543 and later Detachment 252005, comprised about 160 personnel; 145 were captured by the Soviet Union after the war, and four were tried in 1950 in Beili. The files reveal deceptive conscription under the guise of regular infantry, recruiting via units 97, 177 and 201 to conceal biochemical crimes. Ozaki’s 70-minute testimony details three months of bacterial culture training, lab duties, and daily routines enabling experiments, including notes on buried chemical weapons. Singaporean scholar Lin Shaobin emphasizes international cooperation to uncover the Southeast Asia-linked 9420 Detachment, which operated across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, and Myanmar to produce plague-carrying fleas. British POW accounts and U.S. archives are cited to urge broader access to historical materials.

articleSummary: Cholera outbreak reported in Myanmar's Yangon region. The Ministry of Health said on Aug 13, 2026 that more than 90 people have tested positive for Vibrio cholerae. The ministry urged residents to drink boiled water, wash hands thoroughly, and avoid unclean food. Public health measures aim to contain transmission in the affected Yangon districts.
